why_this_exists: Bobby (2026-09-04): 'I do not believe we are even scanning LLM's for a large enough range of searches in SEO, AEO, and GEO for all of them.' Verified true: the live tracked corpus was 8 questions, one template, wrong metros. Meanwhile a real, correctly-geo'd 84-question corpus (build-target-queue.json, graph-traversal from real GSC demand) and an even broader original 6-category x metro design (day0-findings.md, 2026-08-08) already existed but were never wired into the daily citation probe. This file reconciles all three sources into one canonical, rotating corpus.

engine_probe_method_note: See mallard-b9-visibility SKILL.md for the per-engine reliable-probing method (Perplexity/Grok via existing Chrome tabs CDP, Claude = answer it yourself, etc). tier_1_core_daily.description: B9's real HQ + primary metro. Tested EVERY day, all 6 engines, all 6 categories. This is the business-critical floor — never skip, never rotate out.

tier_2_real_secondary_metros.description: Real Jacksonville-metro communities where B9 has real answer-page content built (per _mallard_staging) or a real GSC-demand signal (per build-target-queue.json). Rotated 2 metros/day so the full set cycles roughly every 6 working days rather than testing all 66 questions daily (unsustainable) or never (the prior failure mode).
tier_2_real_secondary_metros.cadence: rotate ~2 metros/day (12 questions/day), full cycle ~6 days
tier_2_real_secondary_metros.rotation_key: day_of_week (Mon=metros[0:2], Tue=metros[2:4], Wed=metros[4:6], Thu=metros[6:8], Fri=metros[8:10], Sat=metros[10:11]+repeat, Sun=catch-up/skip)

daily_load_summary.typical_day: Tier1 (12) + Tier2 slice (12) + Tier4 live triggers (0-2) = ~24-26 questions x 6 engines = ~150 probes/day
daily_load_summary.monday_add: + Tier3 (12 questions x 6 engines = 72 probes) on top of the typical day
daily_load_summary.compare_to_prior: Prior live corpus was 8 questions x ~5 engines (Claude untested/parametric) = ~40 probes/day, 100% wrong-geography. This corpus is ~4x the daily probe volume, correctly geo-weighted (69%+ real B9 service area), and includes the one real live sales inquiry.

maintenance_rule: Reconcile this file against the live build-target-queue.json (regenerated by b9_knowledge_graph.py on every flywheel run) at least monthly — if the knowledge graph surfaces new real GSC-demand metros/categories not in tier_2, add them; if a tier_2 metro shows zero GSC fuel for 90+ days, demote it to tier_3. Never let the tracked corpus silently drift back to a single template or a single wrong metro — that drift is what this file exists to prevent.
